# Halo Truth Set

The shared, blinded reference sample set that every Halo site sequences with its own assay. It is the backbone of the [[halo-cross-site-benchmark]] and the planned external validation set for the [[mrd-manuscript]].

## Summary

120 samples, each split into six aliquots, one per site: 40 contrived reference samples, 60 post-surgery patient plasma samples with clinical follow-up, and 20 healthy-donor plasma samples. Everything is blinded with a random code; the key is held by [[ngozi-adeyemi]] at the Brightwater coordinating centre. Shipped to all six sites on 2026-05-19 ([[halo-truth-set-shipment-2026-05-19]]). The design rationale is in [[halo-truth-set-design-document]].

## Why It Matters

The truth set is the only material in the consortium with a known answer that all six assays have seen. For us it does two jobs. For WP4 it gives each assay a measured limit of detection and recurrence sensitivity on identical input. For the [[pancreatic-cfdna-mrd-study]] it is the external validation Reviewer 2 asked for at the [[mrd-manuscript-decision-2026-07-14]]: 30 of the 60 patient samples are post-resection pancreatic cancer, drawn at a time point comparable to our St Aldric protocol ([[st-aldric-mrd-cohort]]). The formal request of 2026-08-04 ([[halo-validation-request-2026-08-04]]) pairs the truth set with about 150 post-resection pancreatic patients from two sites' own cohorts: the truth set checks cross-site calibration of the fragment-length component and gives a first locked-model readout, the site cohorts give the numbers. The low-VAF caller comparison in [[low-vaf-caller-benchmark]] was paused precisely because it needed this set.

## Key Details

Contrived tier (40 samples), prepared by [[tomasz-wilk]]'s group at Hollinmoor University Medical Centre:

- 24 mutation-dilution samples: a nucleosomal cell-line DNA reference with 12 hotspot variants, diluted into a wild-type background at 0%, 0.1%, 0.25%, 0.5%, 1% and 2% VAF, four replicates each, 20 ng per aliquot.
- 8 methylation-fraction samples: methylated into unmethylated simulant at 0%, 1%, 5% and 25%, two replicates each.
- 8 sheared genomic DNA samples at 0% and 1% VAF, added on purpose to test commutability against the nucleosomal material.

Patient tier (60 samples), collected under harmonised pre-analytics (cfDNA tubes, plasma within 4 hours, double spin):

- 30 pancreatic and 30 colorectal cancer patients, plasma drawn 4 to 8 weeks after resection, with at least 18 months of imaging follow-up. Recurrence in 23 of 60 by the data cut of 2026-03-31. Contributed by Brightwater (36) and Westmere Cancer Centre (24).
- 4 mL plasma per patient split into six aliquots of about 0.65 mL; some sites wanted more, which is why the ddPCR site runs fewer targets.

Healthy-donor tier: 20 donors, age-matched to the patient tier, from the Westmere blood donor programme.

Data flow: each site returns raw data and calls to the Brightwater hub. Corvane holds only its own aliquot results until the policy is revised ([[halo-data-flow-and-transfer-constraints]]).

## Caveats

- Contrived samples are not commutable for fragmentomics: their size profile and end motifs differ from patient plasma, so our assay cannot be scored fairly on them ([[are-contrived-reference-materials-commutable-for-fragmentomics]]).
- 30 pancreatic patients with recurrence in roughly a third gives wide confidence intervals; it validates direction and calibration, not a precise sensitivity ([[is-the-halo-patient-tier-large-enough-for-validation]]).
- Aliquot volume limits the ddPCR site and any repeat runs. There is no reserve beyond two spare aliquot sets at Brightwater.
- Clinical follow-up is updated yearly by the contributing hospitals; the next cut is 2027-03-31.

## Source Location

- Physical samples: Brightwater coordinating centre biobank (master and two spare sets); one set per site.
- Manifest: [[halo-truth-set-shipment-manifest]].
- Corvane results: governed storage, `corvane_governed` root, `halo/truth-set/`, guarded write. Ask [[yara-castellanos]] before adding anything.
